item.title: CLITON 20Bar Portable Espresso Machine Set Rechargeable Wireless Coffee Set Capsule & Ground Coffee
item.description:
CLITON Portable Coffee Set

Portable Espresso Machine + Wireless Coffee Grinder + Electric Milk Frother

Enjoy fresh, café-quality coffee wherever you go with the CLITON Portable Coffee Set. This complete brewing kit includes a 20 Bar Portable Espresso Machine with Stand, a Wireless Burr Coffee Grinder, and an Electric Milk Frother, giving you everything you need to grind, brew, and froth fresh coffee anytime.

☕ Portable Espresso Machine

Enjoy rich espresso with golden crema anytime.

Features

20 Bar high-pressure extraction
Compatible with ground coffee & Nespresso-compatible capsules
51mm filter basket holds up to 14g coffee
100ml food-grade water tank
Makes up to 2 espresso servings
Portable & lightweight design
Stand for hands-free brewing
IPX5 water-resistant body
Easy disassembly for cleaning
Built-in espresso cup with dust cover
1500mAh rechargeable battery
Up to 60 extractions per full charge
USB Type-C charging (Approx. 3 hours)
⚙️ Wireless Coffee Grinder

Freshly grind coffee beans with professional precision.

Features

1800mAh rechargeable battery
Up to 30 grinding sessions per charge
40 external grind settings
Ceramic conical burr for consistent grinding
Suitable for Espresso, Moka Pot, Pour Over, French Press & Cold Brew
Quiet pure copper motor
One-touch grinding
Auto stop after grinding
USB Type-C charging
Fully detachable for easy cleaning
🥛 Electric Milk Frother

Create smooth milk foam for your favorite coffee drinks.

Features

High-speed mixing motor
304 stainless steel whisk
Food-grade materials
Lightweight & portable
One-button operation
USB rechargeable (Charging Version)
Easy to clean by rinsing under water
Includes storage sleeve for convenient carrying
⭐ Why You'll Love It
Complete coffee brewing solution in one set
Freshly grind, brew, and froth anytime
Perfect for Espresso, Latte, Cappuccino & Flat White
Compact, cordless & travel-friendly
Ideal for home, office, camping, travel & outdoor use
Great gift for coffee lovers

This CLITON Coffee Set lets you enjoy freshly brewed espresso with rich crema, perfectly ground beans, and silky milk foam wherever your day takes you.
